subject: The meaning of a warning message

messages.author: c15b9370bee785f2
messages.subject: The meaning of a warning message
parts:
Hi, all.
I tried to run a parallel mediation model with one categorical IV, two continuous mediator, one continuous DV under the estimator DWLS. While my model was successfully estimated, I encountered the following warning message:
"warning: lavaan wARNING: information will be set to "expected" for estimator = "DWLS"
Just curious, I wonder if anyone know what this warning message means?

messages.author: c15b9370bee785f2
messages.subject: Re: The meaning of a warning message
parts:
Here is the code I use:

library(dplyr)
study.clean.dummycoded <- study.clean %>%
  mutate_at(vars(28), list(~recode(.,'NoCon' = '0', 'HighCon' = '1')))


library(lavaan)
WPSS.ALL <- '#Path model
                WPSS.mean ~ c1*BLAME.mean + b1*ANGER.mean + b2*SYMPATHY.mean
                ANGER.mean ~ a1*BLAME.mean
                SYMPATHY.mean ~ a2*BLAME.mean

                #Indirect effects
                a1b1 := a1*b1
                a2b2 := a2*b2

                #Total effects
                total1 := c1 + (a1*b1)
                total2 := c1 + (a2*b2)
                total.all := c1 + (a1*b1) + (a2*b2)

                ANGER.mean~~SYMPATHY.mean'

fit1.WPSS.ALL <- sem(WPSS.ALL, data = study.clean.dummycoded, test = 'bootstrap', bootstrap = 5000, iseed = 1234, c("Condition"), estimator = "DWLS")
summary(fit1.WPSS.ALL, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE, estimates = TRUE, ci = TRUE)

fitboot <- sem(WPSS.ALL, data = study.clean.dummycoded, estimator = "DWLS", se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)
summary(fitboot, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE, estimates = TRUE, ci = TRUE)

fitboot <- sem(WPSS.ALL, data = study.clean.dummycoded, estimator = "WLS", se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)
summary(fitboot, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE, estimates = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
